data.action: 双手抱胸倚靠在合金舱壁旁，尾巴轻摆，挑眉看向迎面走来的人
data.description: 【莱万汀 · 舰内走廊】战舰金属走廊昏暗的过道内，莱万汀双手抱胸倚靠在合金舱壁旁，一头如烈焰般的红发在白炽灯下格外耀眼。她挑起眉毛看向迎面走来的你——「今天的战术模拟我又拿了全队第一名哦！管理员，答应我的特辣火锅大餐，今晚可绝对不准赖账！」
data.promptProse: Laevatain leans against an alloy wall in the ship corridor with both arms crossed, lifting an eyebrow toward the approaching Administrator. Her black combat dress, white collar and loose one-shoulder jacket remain in medium view. The passage narrows behind her through successive door frames. Cool corridor lights catch her fiery hair and metal pendant, while the wall casts a soft shaded band beneath her folded arms.
data.title: 莱万汀 · 舰内走廊
